summary.text: Beth Hinebaugh is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Karen Shuler Stakem for a seat with no incumbent.
She won the May 12, 2026 Republican primary over Riley Watkins, 430 votes to 370.
